# NEW 2026-11-22 v18.0 Module 18.0-A: 12 Native Multi-Nation IO Voting Resolutions across 7 IOs (oe_io3_resolutions.txt) (oe_io3_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v180_resolutions_parliaments.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Strictly separates unique = yes IOs (middle_kingdom, hre, catholic_church, tatar_yoke,
# japanese_shogunate, oe_io_eurasian_concert) from unique = no IO (autocephalous_patriarchate,
# which NEVER uses international_organization:autocephalous_patriarchate).


# Celestial Tributary Silk Charter (middle_kingdom, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_mk_silk_charter = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_mk_silk_charter
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_mk_silk_charter_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:celestial_governor
							international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_MK_EMPEROR"
				value = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:celestial_governor
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_MK_GOVERNOR"
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_celestial_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_mk_silk_charter
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_mk_silk_charter_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_mk_silk
			scope:recipient = {
				leader_country ?= {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_mk_silk_emperor years = 12 mode = replace }
					change_celestial_authority = { value = 4 }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_mk_silk_tributary years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_mk_silk_charter_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			leader_country ?= { change_celestial_authority = { value = -2 } }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 12
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_LEADER_INITIATIVE" value = 35 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value >= 20 }
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_FAVORABLE_LEADER" value = 25 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value < -30 }
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_DISTRUST_LEADER" value = -30 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# Celestial Maritime Tribute Tariff (middle_kingdom, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_mk_maritime_tariff = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_mk_maritime_tariff
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_mk_maritime_tariff_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
						num_of_ports >= 4
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_MK_EMPEROR" value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:celestial_governor country = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_MK_GOVERNOR" value = 1 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_celestial_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_mk_maritime_tariff
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_mk_maritime_tariff_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_mk_tariff
			scope:recipient = {
				leader_country ?= {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_mk_tariff_emperor years = 12 mode = replace }
					change_celestial_authority = { value = 3 }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_mk_tariff_member years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_mk_maritime_tariff_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 8
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_of_ports >= 4 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_MARITIME_STAKE" value = 30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { num_of_ports < 1 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_INLAND_CAUTION" value = -15 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# Imperial Examination Scholarly Exchange (middle_kingdom, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_mk_exam_exchange = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_mk_exam_exchange
			}
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_mk_exam_exchange_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_MK_EMPEROR" value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:celestial_governor country = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_MK_GOVERNOR" value = 1 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:policy_vote
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_mk_exam_exchange
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_mk_exam_exchange_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_mk_exam
			scope:recipient = {
				leader_country ?= {
					change_celestial_authority = { value = 3 }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no num_locations > 0 }
					add_research_progress = research_progress_weak_bonus
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_mk_exam_exchange years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_mk_exam_exchange_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_PEACETIME_REFORM" value = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes war_exhaustion >= 5 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_WAR_STRAIN" value = -25 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# Ecumenical Synod Peace Accord (autocephalous_patriarchate, unique=no)
oe_io3_res_ap_synod_peace = {
	international_organization_type = autocephalous_patriarchate
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = autocephalous_patriarchate }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = autocephalous_patriarchate }
			autocephalous_patriarchate ?= {
				OR = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_ap_synod_peace
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_ap_synod_peace_cd }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_AP_PATRIARCH_SEAT" value = 2 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:join_autocephalous_patriarchate
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_ap_synod_peace
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_ap_synod_peace_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_ap_peace
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no num_locations > 0 }
					add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_weak_bonus
					add_religious_influence = religious_influence_weak_bonus
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_ap_synod_peace years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_2 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_2 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.2
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_ap_synod_peace_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 12
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { war_exhaustion >= 2 is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_SYNOD_PEACE_NEED" value = 30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes war_exhaustion < 1 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_BELLIGERENT_RULER" value = -15 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_ap_monastic_endow_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_ap_monastic

					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.2
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_ap_monastic_endow_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 10
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { religious_unity < 0.90 is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_FAITH_PATRONAGE" value = 30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { num_loans >= 3 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_TREASURY_STRAIN" value = -25 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# HRE Imperial Circle Defense Compact (hre, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_hre_circle_defense = {
	international_organization_type = hre
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:hre
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:hre = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_hre_circle_defense
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:hre = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_hre_circle_defense_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
						is_elector = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_HRE_EMPEROR" value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_elector = yes } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_HRE_ELECTOR" value = 1 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:policy_vote
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:hre
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_hre_circle_defense
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_hre_circle_defense_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_hre_defense
			change_imperial_authority = { value = 3 }
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no num_locations > 0 }
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_hre_circle_defense years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_3 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_3 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.3
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_hre_circle_defense_cd years = 6 }
		}
		change_imperial_authority = { value = -2 }
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 12
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { at_war = yes is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_DEFENSE_URGENCY" value = 35 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value < -40 }
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_DISTRUST_LEADER" value = -30 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# HRE Common Penny (Reichssteuer) (hre, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_hre_reichssteuer = {
	international_organization_type = hre
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:hre
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:hre = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_hre_reichssteuer
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:hre = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_hre_reichssteuer_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_HRE_EMPEROR" value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_elector = yes } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_HRE_ELECTOR" value = 1 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:policy_vote
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:hre
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_hre_reichssteuer
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_hre_reichssteuer_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_hre_tax
			change_imperial_authority = { value = 4 }
			scope:recipient = {
				leader_country ?= {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_hre_reichssteuer_emp years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_hre_reichssteuer_mem years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_3 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_3 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.3
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_hre_reichssteuer_cd years = 6 }
		}
		change_imperial_authority = { value = -2 }
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 4
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_LEADER_INITIATIVE" value = 50 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value >= 40 }
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_FAVORABLE_LEADER" value = 25 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					num_loans >= 2
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_TREASURY_STRAIN" value = -30 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# Catholic Truce of God Bull (catholic_church, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_cath_truce_of_god = {
	international_organization_type = catholic_church
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:catholic_church
		papacy_active = yes
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:catholic_church
		}
		religion:catholic = { modifier:curia_actions_blocked = no }
		OR = {
			international_organization:catholic_church = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_cath_truce_of_god
			}
			international_organization:catholic_church = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_cath_truce_of_god_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_CARDINALS"
			value = scope:actor.num_cardinals
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_PAPAL_SEE" value = 2 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:propose_curia_action
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:catholic_church
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_cath_truce_of_god
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_cath_truce_of_god_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_cath_truce
			change_papal_authority = { value = 4 }
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no num_locations > 0 }
					add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_weak_bonus
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_cath_truce_of_god years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_4 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_4 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.4
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_cath_truce_of_god_cd years = 6 }
		}
		change_papal_authority = { value = -2 }
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 10
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { war_exhaustion >= 2 is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_SYNOD_PEACE_NEED" value = 30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes war_exhaustion < 1 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_BELLIGERENT_RULER" value = -15 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# Tatar Yoke Yarlik Tax & Steppe Relay (tatar_yoke, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_ty_yarlik_relay = {
	international_organization_type = tatar_yoke
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:tatar_yoke = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_ty_yarlik_relay
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:tatar_yoke = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_ty_yarlik_relay_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:tatar_tax_collector
							international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_TY_OVERLORD" value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:tatar_tax_collector country = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_TY_COLLECTOR" value = 1 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:policy_vote
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tatar_yoke
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_ty_yarlik_relay
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_ty_yarlik_relay_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_ty_yarlik
			scope:recipient = {
				leader_country ?= {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_ty_yarlik_overlord years = 12 mode = replace }
					if = {
						limit = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
						add_horde_unity = 5
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { government_type = government_type:tribe }
						add_tribal_cohesion = 5
					}
					else = {
						add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
					}
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_ty_yarlik_relay_mem years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_5 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_5 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.5
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_ty_yarlik_relay_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 8
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_LEADER_INITIATIVE" value = 45 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value < -20 }
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_DISTRUST_LEADER" value = -30 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# Bakufu Buke Shohatto & Maritime Patrol (japanese_shogunate, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_shog_bakufu_code = {
	international_organization_type = japanese_shogunate
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:japanese_shogunate = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_shog_bakufu_code
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:japanese_shogunate = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_shog_bakufu_code_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:shugo_daimyo
							international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_SHOGUN" value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:shugo_daimyo country = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_SHUGO_DAIMYO" value = 1 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:policy_vote
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:japanese_shogunate
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_shog_bakufu_code
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_shog_bakufu_code_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_shog_bakufu
			scope:recipient = {
				leader_country ?= {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_shog_bakufu_leader years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_shog_bakufu_member years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_5 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_5 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.5
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_shog_bakufu_code_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 10
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_LEADER_INITIATIVE" value = 40 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value < -30 }
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_DISTRUST_LEADER" value = -25 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}


# Concert Trade Freedom & Balance Mandate (oe_io_eurasian_concert, unique=yes)
oe_io3_res_con_trade_balance = {
	international_organization_type = oe_io_eurasian_concert
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_con_trade_balance
			}
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_res_con_trade_balance_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat country = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			add = { desc = "OE_IO3_VOTE_CON_PENTARCHY" value = 2 }
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_concert_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_io3_res_con_trade_balance
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_con_trade_balance_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_io3_tt_res_con_trade
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no num_locations > 0 }
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_io3_mod_con_trade_balance years = 12 mode = replace }
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
								type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
								international_organization = scope:recipient
							}
						}
						add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
					}
				}
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_6 } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_6 years = 15 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.6
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_con_trade_balance_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						num_of_ports >= 4
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
							international_organization = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_MARITIME_STAKE" value = 30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes war_exhaustion >= 5 }
				add = { desc = "OE_IO3_AI_WAR_STRAIN" value = -20 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}
